examples.text: 1912, Martin Luther, Lutherbibel von 1912, Deuteronomy 32:4 (with KJV translation)
examples.translation: He is the Rock, his work is perfect: for all his ways are judgment: a God of truth and without iniquity, just and right is he.
examples.english: He is the Rock, his work is perfect: for all his ways are judgment: a God of truth and without iniquity, just and right is he.
